page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What a genophore is
steps.margin_note: Definition, alternative names, and the shape. Four lines.
lines: The GENOPHORE is the main genetic material of a
It is also called the bacterial chromosome or the
It is a single, circular, double stranded DNA
steps.why: Circular and single is the shape that lets a bacterium copy its whole genome from one starting point, unlike the many linear chromosomes of a eukaryote.
common_mistakes: Saying the genophore is linear. It is CIRCULAR.
Confusing it with a plasmid. The genophore is the MAIN genetic material; a plasmid is extra.
steps.memory_tip: One circle of DNA, and it is the main one.

steps.label: How it differs from a chromosome
steps.margin_note: Both differences named. The word naked is the shortest way to earn this.

lines.text: Naked DNA: no histones, no nuclear membrane

lines: The genophore is NAKED — it carries no histone
It is not enclosed by a nuclear membrane.
A eukaryotic chromosome has histones and lies
steps.why: Bacteria have no nucleus and no histones, so the genophore is built differently from a eukaryotic chromosome, even though it is called the bacterial chromosome.
common_mistakes: Saying the genophore has histones. It is NAKED DNA.
Saying it lies in a nucleus. Bacteria have no nuclear membrane.
steps.memory_tip: No histones and no nuclear membrane: that is how it differs from a eukaryotic chromosome.
